mapper.select: SELECT id,incident_title title,incident_status status,incident_severity severity,lifecycle_version,incident_commander commander_id,opened_at,resolved_at FROM t_incident ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id,incident_title title,incident_status status,incident_severity severity,lifecycle_version,incident_commander commander_id,opened_at,resolved_at FROM t_incident WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_incident SET incident_commander=#{user},lifecycle_version=lifecycle_version+1,status_reason=#{reason},status_changed_by=#{actor} WHERE id=#{id} AND lifecycle_version=#{version} AND incident_status NOT IN ('CLOSED','ARCHIVED')
